name: bluechip Agents and automations
description: [bluechip] Agents created and locked, their states and changes, and automation runs.

query.mpl:
`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.created`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.locked`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| where `outcome` == "locked"
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.runs`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.judgments`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align using sum
| group using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.created`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `template` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.locked`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.active`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using avg
| group by `state` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.lifecycle`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `change` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.agents.sessions_expiring`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using avg
| group by `within` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.active`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using avg
| group by `trigger` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.runs`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `outcome` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.runs`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `trigger` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.skipped`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `condition` using sum

`${METRICS_DATASET}`:`bluechip.automations.judgments`
| where `deployment.environment` == $env
| align to $__interval using sum
| group by `verdict` using sum
